Update28 May 2026·All news·Original post on aa-classic.com
📜 Patch Notes - May 28, 2026
Customize your game with the new Nametag Color system! Pick your own colors in the options menu, enjoy improved persistent Divine Die buffs and a new guild flare raid selection tool.

Features

  • The Pawesome Festival in Windscour Savannah has now ended!
  • Divine Dies now apply an improved version of the combined rune buff, which will persist through death.
  • Kapiros continues to crave entire barrels of oranges.
  • Nametag colors can now be set in the game's options menu
    • ArcheAge Classic Settings > Screen Options
  • "Raid Select" button added to the Guild's Member page, which can be used to quickly select all members in your raid.
  • A new loading screen has been added.
  • Chat mutes no longer affect unmoderated channels (Guild, Family)

Bug Fixes

  • The Egg Basket Teleport Scroll now fully mimics the default teleport book in functionality.
  • The Barrel Assembly Table used to feed Kapiros, and his appetite, no longer take an hour break every night.
  • Tome of Power and Tome of Fortitude now properly apply their buffs to players.

Addon API

The Addon API has been updated to include the following functions:

  • NOTE: All of the following functions expect a decimal color passed in as a string. Example of friendly-green "16773220"
  • api.Nametag:SetColorFriendly
  • api.Nametag:SetColorFriendlyNPC
  • api.Nametag:SetColorNeutral
  • api.Nametag:SetColorParty
  • api.Nametag:SetColorRaid
  • api.Nametag:SetColorRaidPK
  • api.Nametag:SetColorPK
  • api.Nametag:SetColorEnemy
  • api.Nametag:SetColorMonster
  • api.Nametag:SetColorPirate
